findings.title_text: s.40A(2)(b) does not apply to this amount for related person (tag 0c05ee00) -- s.40(b) governs instead (confirm)
limits_text: Related person (tag 0c05ee00) is recorded with relationship 'partner', a client confirmation of partner status, and this engagement's rules apply s.40(b) to a partner's interest and remuneration; on that basis s.40A(2)(b) does not additionally apply to the same amount. This rests on the client's own confirmation, not a reading of the deed, so it is stated here for confirmation, not as a settled fact.
ask_client_text: Confirm the partnership deed treats this amount as partner interest or remuneration under s.40(b), not a separate related-party payment under s.40A(2)(b).
